title: Dashboards issue one analytics query per widget (18 on Chart Gallery), and KPI cards repeat their title and truncate large values
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Asked in session on 2026-11-10, after the full-platform test run listed its improvement suggestions, verbatim: 「立卡处理」.

QA-source: #32135 · browser walk (runner C), dashboards · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

- Each widget sends its own `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`: 9 on Delivery Operations, 18 on Chart Gallery, no batching.
- KPI cards are tall and mostly empty, and repeat the title as subtitle ("Avg Progress / 47.0 / Avg Progress"); the Command Center KPI truncates to "$1,090,0…".
- Setup → System Overview shows grey skeletons for 4 s or more.

## Proposed change

A batched dataset query for one dashboard render; KPI card layout that fits the value and drops a subtitle equal to the title.

## Business reason

Who: everyone who opens a dashboard. Cost: slow first paint that grows with widget count, and numbers users cannot read.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `ui/` (dashboard renderer, KPI widget) and the analytics query door.

## Duplicate check

#28085 (open) covers duplicated shell calls on list pages, not per-widget dashboard queries; `is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack duplicate API calls console load` (633) found no dashboard card.
